items.effect: Zero samples approved or shipped this week against 67 requests waiting in To Review, so no new sample-driven creator content lands before the first week of December.
items.action: Triage the 67 To Review requests today and approve every applicant with post rate above 80% and GPM above $10.

items.effect: Delivery at one sample per week cannot sustain 35 creators posting, and 198 of 300 tracked requests are already expired so that pool is gone without new outreach.
items.action: Run one re-request pass on the 198 expired requests and ship the approved backlog before reviewing new applicants.

items.effect: Inbound request volume fell to a third of last week, which points at the 41.5% drop in DMs sent as the upstream cause rather than at creator appetite.
items.action: Lift DM volume back above 100 per week on screen door and Repel umbrellas only, holding the current 22.58% reply rate.

items.effect: Second straight zero week on 56 streams and 222,351 live views, a pattern consistent with product attachment or cart links missing rather than weak audience.
items.action: Audit product attachment and cart links on the 56 streams from this week and pause paid live slots until one stream shows non-zero GMV.

items.effect: Third straight weekly decline from 260 to 53 to 31, and replies improved to 22.58% as volume fell, so send volume is now the constraint on the funnel.
items.action: Restore a weekly send floor of 100 DMs and track replies per 100 sends week over week.
